title: Cross Claim Classification Map
purpose: Support the primary activity for The Cross as the Story's Crisis.
body_markdown:
# Cross Claim Classification Map

Use Mark 14:22-25; 15:33-39 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
